verdict.rationale: Freshsales marketing documents kanban views with drag-and-drop cards for planning the sales process, which covers the visual pipeline and drag-and-drop parts of the story. Deals are a first-class object (Create a Deal API), but customizable pipeline stages are only loosely implied by the word "configure". missing for 10: explicit documentation of customizable deal stages, in-depth first-party docs on the deal pipeline view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: Plan your entire sales process with kanban views, and configure and control with drag-and-drop cards.
